verdict.rationale: Bun keeps project data in open, standard formats. Dependencies live in npm-standard `package.json`, and since v1.2 the default lockfile is a human-readable text `bun.lock`. `bun pm pack` also produces npm-compatible tarballs, so the project stays portable to other npm clients. However, the documented lockfile migration only runs inbound (yarn/npm/pnpm → bun), with no evidence of exporting `bun.lock` back to another manager's format. missing for 10: documented export of bun.lock to package-lock.json/yarn.lock/pnpm-lock.yaml, an official exit/migration-away guide, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving Bun cleanly.
